entry_state: The payable example distinguishes possible answer schedules, individually certain rows and universally true propositions. Relational theorems retain their input/output assumptions and do not certify arbitrary financial queries. Null-space ambiguity and the receivables bridge show why reports cannot identify all movements or contract terms. A balanced signed ledger preserves bookkeeping conservation, while reports also need classified movements, economic state, basis and perimeter. Sections6.2–6.4 are complete; event generation follows.

findings.judgment: The four-stage forward abstraction separates behavior, events, measurement and commit. Date phases govern actual order; allowance expectations cannot use realized future information. History uncertainty, within-history stochasticity, pricing measures and real-world measures retain distinct meanings. Mixture and variance formulas state their measure conditions.

History equivalence is relative to requested outputs, horizon and scenarios. Sample extrema are inner exploration, not certified outer bounds. Principal amounts F,V remove the bilinear unknown fraction-times-total product; the rounded example correctly distinguishes attained lower bound4.975 from unattained supremum7.035. Unsupported, timeout and unbounded responses remain distinct.

chapters/05-mathematics.tex:equation:10.entry_belief: A justified history measure and scalar output are available.

equation.symbols_and_units: Y is scalar with finite second moment; conditional variance and mean are functions of h; Eh and Varh use mu.

equation.derivation_and_status: Write Y−EY=(Y−m(h))+(m(h)−EY); conditional mean-zero makes the expected cross term vanish.
equation.interpretation_and_transition: Within-history uncertainty and uncertainty between conditional means add; uncertain weights require another model class.
equation.source_and_code_boundary: Standard local derivation, applicable only after the measure is supplied.

exit_state: Forward computation separates permitted-information actions, economic events, accounting measurement and atomic state transition. Unweighted history-indexed laws remain a family unless an explicit measurable weighting model is supplied. Total variance needs that measure; uncertain weights require a separate admissible class. Grouping is output/horizon/scenario-relative. Rounded debt is reformulated with principal amounts, preserving attained4.975 versus unattained7.035 and distinct solver outcomes. Section6.9 has begun explicit template construction and continues on91.
